description.value: Rewind Beer Co is a space-time-travel-themed craft brewery and tasting room housed in an industrial building, pouring its own rotating lineup of lagers, IPAs, sours, and saisons alongside guest taps and cider. The taproom doubles as 'Home of Pizza,' serving wood-fired-style pies made in-house with creative toppings and online ordering available. A touring cyclist would find a full sit-down destination with food, craft beer, and a lively atmosphere in Port Moody's industrial corridor.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: rack at 33m; stands (12 spaces) at 79m; stands (6 spaces) at 97m. Total: 18 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and provides strong evidence of an active tasting room and pizza kitchen at 2809 Murray St, Port Moody BC — matching the OSM street address but contradicting the OSM community tag of 'North Vancouver' (Port Moody is a distinct municipality). Bike parking, washrooms, water refill, and most amenities are not mentioned on the website, so those default to null. Takeout is confirmed by an 'Order Online' link, and multiple vegetarian pizza options (e.g. CHEEEEESE, THE SHROOMINATOR) are listed on the menu.
concerns: Municipality mismatch: OSM community tag is 'North Vancouver' but the website clearly states the business is located in Port Moody, BC — these are distinct municipalities. The listing address and map pin should be verified and corrected.
No phone number found in either OSM tags or website content.
